product_metadata.title: Fox Run Red Foil Bake Cups, Mini, 48 Cups
features: Mini size, approx. 1.75 x 1.75 x 0.75 inch
Pack of 48 red food-safe, fluted foil liners
Grease-resistant liners, so outsides remain bright and shiny
Place in muffin tin and fill with your favorite batter
Dress up your cupcakes for your next party
description: Add some elegance to your favorite batch of cupcakes or muffins with these red foil bake cups. These food-safe, fluted baking cups are grease-resistant, so their outsides remain shiny, bright and beautiful. This set includes 48 mini bake cups that are perfect for the holidays or any special occasion. Simply place in a muffin tin and fill with your favorite batter to dress up your cupcakes, or use them to hold candies and other treats.
